description: The generic policy resolver (CPD-3): Node (domain/policy) and Python (harness_core.policy) resolve every case to the same effective config and digest, or the same refusal (code, dimension, layer), over the release's dimension table (policy-dimensions.json). `orders` hold each order kind's leq and meet; `invalidTables` are tables both registries refuse, naming the row. Expectations were computed by the Python resolver and reviewed by hand.

cases.behaviour: no layer: nothing is set
release, org and agent narrow a limit; provenance lists each ceiling
an agent above the org's limit is refused naming the agent
POL-15: two layers widen different dimensions; the top-most is named
one layer widens two dimensions; the first row is named
a user may only choose: a ceiling set by the user layer is not exposed
an operator row below the deployment is not exposed
a choice is the nearest layer's
a choice outside its ceiling is refused naming the layer that chose it
a narrowing below a choice leaves the choice outside: refused, naming the chooser
a model per sub-agent role, each within the routes
a role outside the routes is refused
approvals meet: an agent that allows writes after the org asks still asks (no refusal)
approvals: flow rules from two layers both stay when neither covers the other
a rollout switch the deployment holds off cannot be turned on by an org
an org may turn a rollout switch off
the kill switch: an org cannot lift the deployment's
the kill switch: an org may pull it
an operator row is the deployment's
a value the order cannot read is invalid
the live layer narrows the pin and never widens it
a live layer that widens a refusing ceiling is refused
sub-agents: a depth above the layer above is refused naming the bound
sub-agents switched off normalize to the off value
modes: plan narrows build; review after plan widens
engines: a layer that does not admit the released engine is refused
engines: admitted by kind and by kind@version; the engine stays the release's
isolation of the same rank narrows; a weaker one widens
a ceiling no layer above set is taken as the first layer gives it
an egress allowlist narrows only to none
catalog.approval: a team layer may not lower the org's rule for its kind
catalog.approval: a team raises a rule; the org's wildcard still binds every kind
catalog.approval: a team rule for one kind does not satisfy the org's wildcard
catalog.delegation is the org's alone: a team layer setting it is not exposed
catalog.delegation: the org's set, as a sorted set
approvals: a parent layer carries its pin’s resolved ceiling (no flow rule); a child request narrows it
approvals: a parent’s resolved ceiling with one flow rule is read as it was resolved
approvals: a parent’s resolved ceiling with two flow rules neither of which covers the other keeps both
approvals: a child request looser than its parent’s resolved ceiling changes nothing (approvals meet)
approvals: a child request’s flow rule that covers both of its parent’s replaces them
approvals: a resolved ceiling with a flow rule the schema refuses is invalid, never read looser
approvals: a resolved ceiling with a level the schema refuses is invalid
MA1: a lower layer's higher cost ceiling for a role is met, never above the org's
MA1: a cost ceiling that is not a map of numbers is invalid
MA1: the request layer may not set a cost ceiling
C4.02: a choice the org locked is not overridable by the user
C4.02: repeating a locked choice changes nothing; the dimension names its lock
C4.02: a locked ceiling may still be narrowed below
C4.02: widening a locked ceiling is refused as locked
C4.02: a lock on a choice no layer set keeps it unset below
C4.02: an agent layer whose section the org owns carries the org's lock
C4.02: a section owned by a layer below the lock carries nothing
C4.02: a lock that names no dimension is invalid
C4.02: a layer may lock only what it may set
C4.02: the topmost lock holds
C5.01: a tool-disclosure mode outside the org's modes is refused
C5.01: the request layer may not pick the tool-disclosure mode
C4.02: a locked approval rule set still meets a stricter or looser layer without refusing
C5.01: the agent picks a disclosure mode inside the org's

invalidTables.behaviour: a choice within a dimension that is no ceiling
an operator row exposed below the deployment
a ranked value in two groups
